description: This file defines a singleton object 'ScorePrefs' that manages persistent storage of game scores for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including methods to retrieve, increment, and reset the scores using Android shared preferences.

methods.name: prefs
methods.description: Returns the SharedPreferences instance for the app's score storage.

methods.name: getXWins
methods.description: Retrieves the number of wins for 'X' from shared preferences.

methods.name: getOWins
methods.description: Retrieves the number of wins for 'O' from shared preferences.

methods.name: getDraws
methods.description: Retrieves the number of draws from shared preferences.

methods.name: incrementXWins
methods.description: Increments the 'X' wins count in shared preferences.

methods.name: incrementOWins
methods.description: Increments the 'O' wins count in shared preferences.

methods.name: incrementDraws
methods.description: Increments the draws count in shared preferences.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all game score counts to zero in shared preferences.
